n6bd729d847.headline: S&P discloses the economic impacts of a possible Russia-Ukraine agreement on Azerbaijan and region
n6bd729d847.summary: S&P Global Ratings notes a high degree of uncertainty about the extent, outcome and consequences of the Russia-Ukraine war, and has disclosed possible economic impacts for Azerbaijan and the region.
n6bd729d847.why: S&P Global Ratings is a major credit rating agency, and its sovereign assessments influence borrowing costs for issuers.

nc1593dfc1a.headline: Australia moves to arm troops with anti-ship missiles as China threat looms
nc1593dfc1a.summary: The UK environment department has closed a nature-friendly farming scheme to new applicants, a move described by critics as another shattering blow to the sector. The sector is already in dispute with government.
nc1593dfc1a.why: Farm subsidy schemes provide income to agricultural businesses and set the economics of land use in the UK. Changes to them affect farm incomes and food supply chains.

n6a2d3ce2c2.headline: Vietnam and EIB strengthen financial cooperation
n6a2d3ce2c2.summary: Vietnam and the European Investment Bank are working to deepen financial ties. Details of specific measures were not reported.
n6a2d3ce2c2.why: The European Investment Bank is the European Union's lending arm, and its partnerships fund infrastructure and development projects in emerging markets.

n59ce61e7f7.headline: EU announces a $5 billion investment in South Africa as the tariffs war with Trump escalates
n59ce61e7f7.summary: European Union leaders announced a 4.7 billion euro, or about $5.1 billion, investment package in South Africa. It is intended to support the green energy transition and vaccine production amid the US tariffs dispute.
n59ce61e7f7.why: EU investment packages fund infrastructure and industrial projects, and South Africa is a major African economy with significant trade ties to Europe.

ncae60d50b3.headline: After P2P trading, hybrid finance apps are taking off in Nigeria’s crypto space
ncae60d50b3.summary: Hybrid finance apps combining TradFi and DeFi features let Nigerian users convert crypto to naira without escrow or peer-to-peer trading. Startups including Taja, Palremit and Pandar have emerged since mid-2023.
ncae60d50b3.why: Nigeria is one of Africa's largest crypto markets, and naira-crypto conversion is central to how individuals hedge currency risk. Developments here indicate the growth of digital asset access in emerging markets.

na90fdfcef0.headline: These are the new food items added to the VAT-free list ... and why not everyone's impressed
na90fdfcef0.summary: South Africa has added new food items to its VAT-free list, though critics say zero-rating is a blunt tool because prices are not guaranteed to fall.
na90fdfcef0.why: VAT changes on food alter consumer prices and government tax revenue, which matter for retailers and inflation trends.

n237792971d.headline: Cucinelli posts higher profits, confirms sales guidance
n237792971d.summary: Italian luxury group Brunello Cucinelli said operating profit rose 12.9% last year to 212 million euros, slightly below analyst expectations, and confirmed sales growth of around 10% for 2025 and 2026.
n237792971d.why: Brunello Cucinelli is a high-end Italian cashmere and luxury apparel group, and its guidance is a read-through for demand in the luxury sector.

n76974a35cf.headline: Phoenix Financial Publishes Results for 2024
n76974a35cf.summary: Israel-based asset management, insurance and financial group Phoenix Financial has published its results for 2024.
n76974a35cf.why: Phoenix Financial is an Israeli insurance and asset management group listed on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange.

n1570d8cdf4.headline: Major parties reject South Africa budget leaving uncertain path ahead
n1570d8cdf4.summary: Disputes between the two biggest parties in South Africa's coalition government have led major parties to reject the budget. The disputes could lead to the coalition's collapse.
n1570d8cdf4.why: Budget approval and government stability affect fiscal policy, government bond investors and the rand.

n69ebb9a515.headline: S&P: Remittances from Russia to Azerbaijan and regional countries to decrease
n69ebb9a515.summary: S&P Global Ratings said a possible Russia-Ukraine agreement would reduce remittances from Russia to Azerbaijan and other Central Asian and South Caucasus countries. The agency sees a decline in those inflows.
n69ebb9a515.why: Remittances are a major source of household income and foreign currency inflows for many emerging economies in the region.

nca99692ee6.headline: Spain's top court backs Barcelona's plan to ban holiday apartments
nca99692ee6.summary: One of Spain's top courts backed Barcelona's plan to ban holiday apartment rentals by 2028, rejecting an appeal that argued the measure infringed private property rights.
nca99692ee6.why: Short-term rental restrictions affect property values, tourism-related revenue and the business models of platforms that list holiday apartments.

nfa54a2b312.headline: MG fights back in the battle for Australia's cheapest new car
nfa54a2b312.summary: MG has slashed prices for entry-level versions of its MG 3, MG 5 and HS models, with sharper runout discounts, in the battle for Australia's cheapest new car.
nfa54a2b312.why: MG is a budget car brand owned by China's SAIC, and price competition in entry-level models affects market share in the Australian new-car segment.

nc5ec66c88a.headline: Number on Universal Credit for health or disability up by half a million in year
nc5ec66c88a.summary: The number of people receiving Universal Credit for health or disability rose by half a million over the year, reaching 2.5 million last year.
nc5ec66c88a.why: Universal Credit is the main UK means-tested benefit, and rising health-related claims affect public spending, the fiscal outlook and labour market participation.

ndc11141e6d.headline: Coalition criticises Labor over ‘skyrocketing’ power price rises – but Dutton won’t guarantee lower bills
ndc11141e6d.summary: The Coalition criticised Labor over rising power prices, but Peter Dutton declined to guarantee lower bills. He also would not say whether he would back further household energy rebates if elected.
ndc11141e6d.why: Electricity prices and household energy rebates shape consumer spending, inflation and the energy policy agenda ahead of Australian elections.

n6d375459ed.headline: Enel 2024 net profit +9.6% - Business - Ansa.it
n6d375459ed.summary: Enel reported 2024 net profit up 9.6% to 7.135 billion euros. Ordinary EBITDA rose 3.8% to 22,801 million euros, and net debt fell 7.3% to 55,767 million.
n6d375459ed.why: Enel is an Italian utility with power generation and electricity distribution businesses in Europe and the Americas, so its results reflect the power sector's economics.

ne8b499b197.headline: European stocks gain as investors eye tariff developments
ne8b499b197.summary: European stock markets hovered above the flatline in mid-morning trading as traders assessed the path ahead for US tariffs. Gains were modest.
ne8b499b197.why: European equity indexes reflect the earnings outlook of large continental companies, which are sensitive to trade policy.

ndcfc792dc1.headline: Finland announces 200 million euros more in aid to Ukraine and closer defense cooperation
ndcfc792dc1.summary: Finland announced a new arms package for Ukraine worth around 200 million euros, or $217 million, and pledged closer defence cooperation with Kyiv.
ndcfc792dc1.why: Defence spending and arms procurement are significant for European defence companies and government budgets.

n9a3a229b85.headline: El Al airlines almost quintuples profit from 2023 | The Jerusalem Post
n9a3a229b85.summary: El Al's 2024 revenue totaled $3.4 billion, 37% higher than in 2023. Fourth-quarter revenue was $851 million, 26% higher than a year earlier, and profit almost quintupled from 2023.
n9a3a229b85.why: El Al is Israel's national airline, and its results reflect air travel demand and fuel and currency costs on long-haul and regional routes.

n35a384a564.headline: Energy bill jolt: price rises power up living cost pain
n35a384a564.summary: A regulator's decision threatens further energy bill increases of up to $200 annually. The prospect adds to household pressure from rising living costs.
n35a384a564.why: Energy price regulation feeds into household costs and inflation, which shape central bank policy and consumer spending.

n6f491bfb69.headline: What Greenland's elections mean for the island — and the U.S.
n6f491bfb69.summary: This week's vote in Greenland resulted in a win for pro-independence forces. It also rejected President Trump's rhetoric about annexing the island.
n6f491bfb69.why: Greenland is an autonomous territory of Denmark with strategic Arctic location and mineral potential, making its political direction relevant to US and European geopolitics.

n95c5a01f59.headline: Eggscellent News: Egg Prices Are Falling
n95c5a01f59.summary: The price of large white shell eggs fell 15 percent in early March. The drop follows months of soaring costs.
n95c5a01f59.why: Food prices feed into US consumer inflation, which influences Federal Reserve policy and household spending.

n6bfec526c9.headline: Social housing cheats ‘defraud taxpayers £1bn a year’
n6bfec526c9.summary: A report has warned that social housing tenants illegally renting out council properties on platforms such as Airbnb are costing UK taxpayers £1bn a year.
n6bfec526c9.why: Social housing is publicly funded through local councils and housing associations, so fraud directly affects public spending and housing supply.

n390aa700ae.headline: Intel jumps 10% as incoming CEO Tan brings 'instant credibility' to turnaround efforts
n390aa700ae.summary: Intel shares jumped 10% as analysts said incoming CEO Lip-Bu Tan brings instant credibility to the turnaround and to the company's push to become a major contract chipmaker.
n390aa700ae.why: Intel is a major US semiconductor designer and manufacturer, and its foundry strategy affects the global chip supply chain.

impacts.name: Intel
impacts.why: Analysts said the incoming CEO adds credibility to the turnaround and foundry efforts, lifting investor sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

n390aa700ae.why_moved: Analysts said incoming CEO Lip-Bu Tan brings instant credibility that should help restore investor confidence.

nd6e9c7414b.headline: Jobs at risk unless demand for electric vehicles is raised, industry body warns
nd6e9c7414b.summary: The Society of Motor Manufacturers and Traders warned that jobs are at risk unless demand for electric vehicles rises, citing the danger of 'de-industrialisation'. The warning comes from Mike Hawes of the SMMT.
nd6e9c7414b.why: The SMMT is the main trade body for UK car and van manufacturers, so its warnings signal pressure on automakers and their supply chains. Demand for electric vehicles is central to the sector's investment and employment outlook.

n4b52c5200e.headline: Millions of Brits now paying more tax than year ago - see if you're one of them
n4b52c5200e.summary: HMRC figures show 5.1 million people paid the higher 40% income tax rate in 2022/23, up 680,000 or 15.3% on the previous year.
n4b52c5200e.why: Income tax thresholds that are not raised with inflation, known as fiscal drag, pull more earners into higher bands and shape household spending and tax revenue.

n6482b19bca.headline: Hudson’s Bay could close up to half of its 80 Canadian stores. Is my gift card still valid? What about reward points? Here’s what you need to know
n6482b19bca.summary: Hudson's Bay could close up to half of its 80 Canadian stores. Gift cards remain usable, but rewards point redemption is paused until further notice.
n6482b19bca.why: Hudson's Bay is a historic Canadian department store chain, and its store closures affect retail real estate and consumer spending in Canada.

n131e72f084.headline: Thailand affirms commitment to boost foreign investment
n131e72f084.summary: Thailand's prime minister Paetongtarn highlighted government efforts to boost investor confidence and show Thailand as a secure investment destination. The remarks were made at a Board of Investment event on March 12.
n131e72f084.why: Thailand's Board of Investment offers incentives to foreign manufacturers, and inflows of foreign direct investment shape growth and the baht.

n8be4f2288a.headline: Wall St set for lower open after Trump's new tariff salvo; spotlight on inflation data - AOL
n8be4f2288a.summary: US index futures pointed to a lower open after Trump threatened 200% duties on European beverage imports unless the EU removes surcharges on US whiskey, while cooling inflation data offered some reprieve.
n8be4f2288a.why: The S&P 500 tracks large US listed companies and is the main benchmark for US equities. Tariff threats on trading partners raise trade-policy and cost risks for exporters and consumer companies.
n8be4f2288a.why_moved: Trump threatened 200% duties on European beverage imports over EU surcharges on US whiskey, while signs of cooling inflation offered some reprieve for investors.

n1aa48f3ba1.headline: Energy bill jolt: price rises power up living cost pain
n1aa48f3ba1.summary: A regulator's decision has raised the threat of further energy bill increases of up to $200 a year, adding to cost-of-living pressure for households.
n1aa48f3ba1.why: Energy regulators set network and retail price rules that feed directly into household costs and inflation. Their decisions affect utilities and energy retailers.

n8233df119d.headline: Post-pandemic property price roller-coaster to flatten
n8233df119d.summary: There are signs Australia's housing market is normalising five years after the COVID-19 pandemic sent home values soaring, with price growth expected to flatten.
n8233df119d.why: Housing prices affect household wealth, mortgage risk and bank lending in Australia. Property is a major driver of the Australian economy and consumer spending.

naa50191d28.headline: Singapore to collaborate with US businesses amid rising protectionism: DPM Gan
naa50191d28.summary: Singapore will collaborate with US businesses despite rising protectionism, according to Deputy Prime Minister Gan. The US embassy described bilateral economic relations as enduring and dynamic.
naa50191d28.why: Singapore is a major trade and financial hub, so its trade ties with the US affect regional commerce and investment flows.

n3c6b7e6392.headline: TSX futures slip amid escalating global trade tensions
n3c6b7e6392.summary: Futures tied to Canada's main stock index dipped as investors assessed the implications of an intensifying trade war with the United States. March S&P/TSX futures were lower.
n3c6b7e6392.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity benchmark, and it is heavily weighted toward banks, energy and resources exposed to US trade.
n3c6b7e6392.why_moved: Investors assessed the implications of an intensifying US trade war, which pushed the TSX futures lower.

n5fceabaa87.headline: Trump threatens more tariffs as EU, Canada push back against existing trade barriers - Invezz
n5fceabaa87.summary: Trump threatened more tariffs as the EU and Canada pushed back against existing trade barriers. The article presents the trade dispute as ongoing.
n5fceabaa87.why: Tariff escalation between the US and its major trading partners raises costs for exporters and can affect global supply chains.

n21a19964eb.headline: Europe's Idling Factories Eye New Start in the Military -- 2nd Update
n21a19964eb.summary: Europe's industrial production recovered at the start of the year, with major defence investment expected to revive the beleaguered manufacturing sector. The Bloomberg-style report notes idle factories are looking toward military orders.
n21a19964eb.why: Industrial production trends affect European growth, and defence spending is a growing driver of manufacturing demand.

n174c22a24b.headline: VPBank builds digital branchless bank to serve millions of customers
n174c22a24b.summary: VPBank is building a digital, branchless bank to serve millions of customers. The company says a comprehensive AI capability requires a seamless and strong digital ecosystem.
n174c22a24b.why: VPBank is one of Vietnam's large private commercial banks, and its digital strategy affects retail banking growth and competition in the Vietnamese market.

n4b012a2661.headline: PSP Investments joins CPP Investments and Ferrovial in 407 ETR ownership group
n4b012a2661.summary: Public Sector Pension Investment Board (PSP Investments) joined CPP Investments and Ferrovial in the ownership group of 407 ETR, the Toronto toll highway. The announcement was made via a PR Newswire release.
n4b012a2661.why: PSP Investments is one of Canada's large pension investors, and infrastructure stakes like 407 ETR are a core part of its long-term portfolio.

impacts.name: Ferrovial
impacts.why: Ferrovial is an existing co-owner of 407 ETR alongside the new investor.

n6f03730769.headline: Spirits and wine once again 'collateral damage' in transatlantic trade tariffs
n6f03730769.summary: The European Commission announced new rebalancing tariffs on American whiskey, potentially subjecting it to a 50% levy from April. Spirits and wine producers are again affected by transatlantic tariffs.
n6f03730769.why: Tariffs on spirits and wine affect exporters and importers across the transatlantic trade relationship between the EU and the United States.

nd6b8c6ceb4.headline: Taiwan tech giant Foxconn’s 2024 profit misses forecasts
nd6b8c6ceb4.summary: Taiwan's Foxconn reported full-year 2024 net profit up 7% to NT$152.7 billion, which missed forecasts.
nd6b8c6ceb4.why: Foxconn is the world's largest contract electronics manufacturer and a key assembler for Apple, so its results signal demand across consumer electronics supply chains.

nc4cebfab28.headline: Exclusive-UBS considers sale of some real estate assets in asset management unit, sources say
nc4cebfab28.summary: UBS is considering selling part of its asset management division that is largely focused on real estate investments, according to sources cited by Reuters.
nc4cebfab28.why: UBS is Switzerland's largest bank and a major wealth and asset manager, so portfolio changes in its asset management arm affect its strategy and earnings mix.

n679cd2b12f.headline: Koreans primed for high-tech investment
n679cd2b12f.summary: South Korean businesses are expected to invest more in technology fields such as AI, semiconductors and green energy, aiming to make Vietnam a global investment hub.
n679cd2b12f.why: Foreign direct investment in high-tech sectors shapes industrial growth and supply chains, and Vietnam has become a major manufacturing hub for electronics.

nc463d0ab21.headline: Uttar Pradesh goes past Delhi with over 15k companies registered in FY25 so far
nc463d0ab21.summary: Uttar Pradesh added 15,590 new companies between April 2024 and January 2025, surpassing Delhi in company registrations for the period.
nc463d0ab21.why: Company registration trends signal business formation and investment activity across Indian states.

n4a9a0fd7cd.headline: Europe: Shares close loser after Trump threatens new tariffs; German reforms in focus
n4a9a0fd7cd.summary: European shares closed slightly lower after US President Donald Trump threatened tariffs on alcoholic products from the European Union, adding to global trade tensions.
n4a9a0fd7cd.why: Tariffs on EU goods can hit exporters and weigh on European equity indexes, while broader trade tensions affect global growth expectations.
n4a9a0fd7cd.why_moved: Trump's threat of new tariffs on EU alcoholic products added to trade tensions, pushing European shares slightly lower.

nebfec2868e.headline: Elon Musk's Tesla Suffers Historic 50% Drop in Share Price Since December
nebfec2868e.summary: Tesla stock has plunged 50% since December, rattling investors, with JPMorgan analysts saying they struggle to find a comparable loss of value in automotive history.
nebfec2868e.why: Tesla is a leading US electric vehicle maker, and its share price moves influence EV sector sentiment and large growth-stock portfolios.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: The stock has fallen about 50% since December, a sharp loss of market value.

nebfec2868e.why_moved: Investor anxiety over the share price slide since December, which JPMorgan analysts described as an unusually rapid loss of value for an automaker.

nb9ed0bc4c9.headline: Hanoi’s serviced apartment sector benefits from surging FDI
nb9ed0bc4c9.summary: The serviced apartment market in Hanoi continues to grow robustly, benefiting from surging foreign direct investment.
nb9ed0bc4c9.why: Foreign direct investment drives demand for commercial and serviced accommodation in fast-growing Vietnamese cities.

n59ccced3cb.headline: Canada's Couche-Tard's chief stresses 'friendly' interest in Japan's 7-Eleven chain
n59ccced3cb.summary: Canada's Alimentation Couche-Tard has reiterated its determination to acquire Seven & i Holdings, although the operator of Japan's top convenience store chain has rejected its offer.
n59ccced3cb.why: Seven & i owns the 7-Eleven convenience store chain in Japan, and cross-border takeover bids can reshape large retail groups.

impacts.why: Couche-Tard is pursuing an acquisition of Seven & i despite the rejection.

n594908eb76.headline: Thai hotelier eyes US expansion to draw on White Lotus craze, the HBO hit TV series
n594908eb76.summary: Minor International, whose hotels in Thailand feature in the HBO series White Lotus, plans to expand in the US as room bookings have skyrocketed since the show began airing.
n594908eb76.why: Minor International is a Thai hospitality group operating hotels and resorts, and its growth plans reflect tourism demand in Thailand and abroad.

n600c397b38.headline: Indian IT stocks extend losses: Infosys, L&T, Wipro fall for fifth session - Invezz
n600c397b38.summary: Shares of Infosys, L&T and Wipro fell for a fifth straight session, extending losses in Indian IT stocks.
n600c397b38.why: Infosys and Wipro are large Indian IT services exporters whose earnings depend heavily on US and European clients.

impacts.name: Wipro
impacts.why: Wipro shares also fell over the same five-session period.

nc89e4fdc85.headline: Trump Announces New Front in His Global Trade War
nc89e4fdc85.summary: US President Donald Trump has announced new tariffs affecting Europe. The move adds a new front to his global trade campaign.
nc89e4fdc85.why: Tariffs on European goods affect exporters, supply chains and trade relations between the US and the European Union.
nc89e4fdc85.why_moved: The input reports new tariffs against Europe as part of Trump's global trade campaign, which raises trade-war uncertainty for European exporters.

n0f98fe0f63.headline: Trump threatens 200% tariff on European alcohol as trade war escalates
n0f98fe0f63.summary: President Donald Trump is threatening a 200% tariff on European alcohol. The threat is a response to the EU's 50% tariff on US whiskey.
n0f98fe0f63.why: Tariffs on spirits and wine affect transatlantic trade flows, and escalation can hit exporters, importers and retailers on both sides.

n2cafdc07e1.headline: UK food and drink exports to the EU down 34% since Brexit
n2cafdc07e1.summary: UK food and drink exports to the EU are down 34 percent since Brexit. The Food and Drink Federation says businesses are struggling with added complexity and bureaucracy.
n2cafdc07e1.why: The EU is a major market for British food producers, so post-Brexit trade frictions directly affect export revenues and sector competitiveness.

nce767b59df.headline: BoJ’s Ueda expects real wages to rise, boosting consumption
nce767b59df.summary: BoJ Governor Kazuo Ueda told parliament that import-cost-driven inflation is expected to moderate while wages continue to rise steadily, improving real wages and consumption.
nce767b59df.why: The Bank of Japan sets monetary policy for Japan, and its view on wages and inflation shapes yen moves and Japanese equity sentiment.

n604cf5d2d5.headline: China is taking issue with Trump’s move to link tariffs to fentanyl
n604cf5d2d5.summary: China's foreign minister criticised the US for responding to China's goodwill with tariffs. The remarks target Trump's move to link tariffs to fentanyl.
n604cf5d2d5.why: Tariff disputes between the US and China affect global supply chains, trade flows and the earnings of exporters in both economies.

n084b5b1d2d.headline: K bank pursues IPO for third time
n084b5b1d2d.summary: K bank, South Korea's internet-only bank, is making a third attempt at an IPO, targeting a 5 trillion won valuation. The move follows record earnings last year.
n084b5b1d2d.why: K bank is an internet-only lender in South Korea, and its listing would test investor appetite for digital banks in the country.

n803350605b.headline: Court dismisses impeachments, reinstates chief auditor, prosecutors
n803350605b.summary: South Korea's Constitutional Court dismissed impeachments and reinstated the chief auditor and prosecutors. The verdict is expected to affect President Yoon's trial.
n803350605b.why: Political stability and the legal status of senior officials affect investor confidence in South Korea's government and economic policy.

nde5e486566.headline: Gold nears new highs as US inflation cools, trade war escalates: how will markets react?
nde5e486566.summary: Gold is nearing new highs as US inflation cools and the trade war escalates. Investors are weighing how markets will respond.
nde5e486566.why: Gold is a traditional safe-haven asset that often attracts demand during trade tensions and when inflation and interest-rate expectations shift.

impacts.why: Gold is nearing new highs, driven by cooling inflation and escalating trade tensions.

n20fc5df870.headline: CK Sees Fewer Home Sales Due To Trade War
n20fc5df870.summary: Local realtors say the US-Canada trade war is keeping home buyers and sellers on the sidelines in Chatham-Kent. The Chatham-Kent Association of Realtors reported 66 residential sales.
n20fc5df870.why: Housing activity is a key indicator of consumer confidence and local economic conditions in Canadian regions.

n2e16298dfb.headline: Ballard Reports Q4 2024 Results
n2e16298dfb.summary: Ballard Power Systems, listed on NASDAQ and the TSX, announced consolidated financial results for the fourth quarter ended December 31, 2024.
n2e16298dfb.why: Ballard is a Canadian maker of hydrogen fuel-cell systems for transport and stationary power, so its quarterly results show demand and margins in the hydrogen sector.
